body: Peacemakers do not share the anti-hegemonist assumption that the world consists of states which are, at root, defensive and security-seeking. To the contrary, many progressives who embrace solidarity as a priority conviction also recognize “a global trend toward authoritarianism and nationalist forms of politics in every continent and in multiple countries, including of course here in the United States.”28 Progressives of this mold have acknowledged that while the current era is “defined by revanchist authoritarianism,” rather than confront dictators militarily, “the United States should embody the world order necessary for its survival and think instead in terms of restorative justice.”29
In a mainstream national security mindset, such belief may seem a puzzling mismatch between problem and response. But
